note: OBSERVED RESULTS ONLY. Scores, opponents, venue and record are deterministic schedule facts. No play-by-play, EPA, success, opponent adjustment, market performance or predictive claim is present.

integrity.algorithm: SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON for the data object (sorted object keys, no insignificant whitespace).

data.period_definition: One row per team, season_type and upstream week label when at least one game is scheduled. Postseason week 1 is distinct from regular-season week 1. A period may contain multiple games.

tier_meaning: Labs — useful and live, still being challenged. Open questions may remain about calibration, assumptions, data quality or edge. Use with your eyes open.
